plan.method: Use random binary linear maps of substring-count parities to generate candidate pools. Pack each pool with the native sparse kernel, then release the pool restriction for full-universe search.
plan.attribution: Inspired by the paper's hashing representation; does not reproduce its uniqueness restriction, odd-cycle argument or asymptotic construction. No deletion property is assumed from equal hash labels.

scope: Eight selected hash fibers with bounded heuristic packing, followed by matched fixed/adaptive full-universe searches. No exhaustive or global-optimality conclusion; positive hash membership never substitutes for independent validity.
